validity: A plan binds only to the (config, FIDESlib binary) pair recorded here. If either differs at the destination, recapture and replan -- a stale plan fails as a silent wrong answer, not an error. Captures are deterministic: to prove a carried-forward plan is still valid, recapture and diff the graph against the archived one; node-identical means the plan holds. This plan's graph predates the current pin, but the plan was EXECUTED on the current binary and passed -- see validated_on_current_pin. Carried forward deliberately: the replan was measured no better.

validated_on_current_pin.method: executed this exact plan on the current binary

**.note: weight_relevels ~1026 is the known benign ViT linear-streaming value. A plan replanned from a fresh capture on this pin gave 323 bootstraps and also passed; per-block time was slightly WORSE (3.61s vs 3.48s).
